author: KingEA owner and Codex
rationale: A closed-bar M30 continuation breakout aligned with an H4 Supertrend and a fixed explainable trend/volatility regime may capture persistent ETHUSD.s moves while avoiding transitional and extreme-volatility entries.
falsification: Reject if either registered spread branch fails any OOS, drawdown, sample-size, parameter-neighbourhood, execution-stress, or untouched-holdout gate. Insufficient qualifying trades is failure and does not authorize widening the search space.

entry_pseudocode: Evaluate exactly once after a complete M30 bar closes.
Require complete and fresh M30/H4 inputs plus the fixed regime classifier.
Require M30 and H4 Supertrend directions to agree.
Require TRENDING regime and NORMAL or HIGH volatility.
LONG: the latest M30 close is above the preceding lookback high plus entry_buffer_atr times ATR and the previous close was not above its corresponding prior threshold.
SHORT: apply the exact inverse rule.
Block if a trade group is already open or any shared safety gate rejects.
stop_pseudocode: LONG technical stop is min(signal_bar_low, M30_supertrend_line) minus stop_buffer_atr times ATR.
SHORT technical stop is max(signal_bar_high, M30_supertrend_line) plus stop_buffer_atr times ATR.
The signal module emits the technical stop but never volume or an order.
The shared safety kernel derives volume and may downsize or reject.
A confirmed protective stop may only tighten.
exit_pseudocode: Exit on the broker-side protective stop.
Exit after a closed M30 bar confirms the opposite Supertrend state.
At progress_checkpoint_bars exit if maximum favourable excursion is below required_progress_r.
A gate-blocked signal expires at that bar and is never queued.

regime_classifier.fail_safe: Incomplete stale transitional ranging or extreme state blocks entry.

fixed_parameters.sessions: All broker-open sessions remain eligible; news spread maintenance weekend margin and safety gates remain authoritative.
fixed_parameters.position_management: Single runner with no partial exit and no add-on.
fixed_parameters.reason: Fixed safety and regime rules reduce optimizer degrees of freedom and enforce the pre-registered explainable v1 design.

validation.branch_rule: Use the worse in-sample ranking score and require both branches to pass independently; neither branch may rescue the other.

cost_and_execution_assumptions.margin_source: Live MT5 symbol/account properties and OrderCalcMargin are authoritative.
cost_and_execution_assumptions.hmr_reference: ETHUSD leverage 1:200 during applicable news HMR; new entries remain blocked by the wider KingEA news window.
cost_and_execution_assumptions.caveat: Demo2 spread authenticity before the registered boundary is unverified. Unchanged recorded spreads are the conservative branch and RSB3 is the mandatory reduced-spread sensitivity branch. Either branch can reject and neither can rescue the other.

acceptance.neighbour_rule_reason: The 1.20 threshold proves the surrounding configurations are not broken; it cannot replace or rescue the selected candidate's 1.30 OOS and stress requirement.

candidate_budget.consumption_rule: Consumption begins only when the first result-bearing job changes the frozen candidate to RUNNING.

source_and_configuration.configuration_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with this configuration_sha256 value replaced by an empty string; keys sorted; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false.

expected_artifacts: Versioned optimizer input and run manifest
Per-fold IS and forward reports for both spread branches
One-time untouched Live2 holdout report only after prior gates pass
